description: Checks that a handoff captures enough state for another agent to resume long-running workflow work without chat history.
Checks that handoff review finds missing continuation details, stale validation claims, and unclear next actions.
Checks that a workflow dry run identifies missing inputs, weak gates, unsafe actions, and a go/revise/blocked decision.
Checks that pull request preparation produces reviewer-ready scope, validation, risks, and follow-up notes from a final diff.
Checks that debugging starts from reproduction, captures the first actionable failure, and ties fixes to evidence.
Checks that skill review identifies weak trigger descriptions, duplicate responsibilities, missing gates, and required metadata edits.
Checks that GitHub PR lifecycle planning keeps PR mutation, merge, and issue changes behind explicit authorization gates.
Checks that Azure DevOps PR lifecycle planning keeps PR mutation, completion, policy, and work item changes behind explicit authorization gates.
Checks that a workflow run cannot advance without declared evidence and preserves the current phase after rejection.
Checks that escalation pauses a run, resolution resumes the same phase, and handoff state is sufficient for continuation.
